svg.title: V-12. System integration build-up (SysML v2 view integrationBuildUp)
svg.desc: System integration build-up generated from the SysML v2 model: the four bottom-up steps of WP-S-08 §3.1 as a staircase, each with the model elements it adds to those of the earlier steps, the interfaces it exercises, its stimulus and purpose, and the number of VS-SI test cases that run at it.
svg.text: Steps I-1 to I-4 of WP-S-08 §3.1: what each adds, the interfaces it exercises, the cases that run at it
Scripted CAN frames and Corolla log replay on bus
Envelope behaviour on target hardware, independent
21 VS-SI cases run at this step
Open-loop Corolla log replay on the CAN side;
process faults injected on the SoC
11 VS-SI cases run at this step
Closed loop with a plant model
no new element: the plant model is bench equipment
Dynamic behaviour at limits; FTTI-relevant timing
8 VS-SI cases run at this step
Integration with existing vehicle elements before
4 VS-SI cases run at this step

Bottom-up: each step keeps what the steps before it integrated (faded) and adds its own elements; its tests must pass before the next starts. 27 VS-SI cases name a step (WP-S-08 §6, Step column). Rows of WP-S-08 §3.1 held cell by cell (check M11).
faded: integrated at an earlier step
